h: Video of Davido and Zlatan pleading with the bride's parents at the wedding stirs online buzz
p: A clip from Zlatan Ibile and Davita's wedding reportedly shows Davido joining the groom to plead with the bride's parents during the traditional ceremony. The video has drawn wide reaction online, with many fans praising the friendship.
more: Davido arrived at the venue in a white Rolls-Royce
Several celebrities were photographed among the guests
